en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who informed him, from Dorost, from a man,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said regarding the Zakāt being sent by the man to a city other than his own city: ‘There is no problem if he were to send the third’, ‘Or a quarter’. The doubt is from Abu Ahmad (the narrator)’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from the one who reported to him from Durust from a man who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who sends his Zakat from one town to another town.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful to send one-third or one-fourth (uncertainty is from narrator).”’
